description:
What is this Part?
This is the Suzuki OEM Pin & Clip that attaches the Emergency Brake Cable to the Hand Brake Handle.
Suzuki OEM Parts
Direct Replacement
What Will I Receive?
Qty 1 – Pin & Cotter
What Vehicle Will This Fit?
Suzuki Samurai 1985 – 1995 All Models
Suzuki SJ413 1985 – 1995 All Models
